The three walls

Tap a wall to see what's on it

Everything listed here came off the shop's own photos — the boxes that were actually on the shelf. What's in today is at the counter.

  • E-liquid — bottles and boxes, shelf after shelf, floor to ceiling.
  • Disposables — a full bay of them, colour-coded by flavour.
  • Devices and mods — boxed, in the middle bays.
  • Pods, coils and tanks — in the glass case under the counter.

  • Water pipes and rigs — the black shelving, top shelf to bottom.
  • Hand pipes — a long lit case of them at the counter, no two the same.
  • Bubblers and small glass — worked colour, one-offs.

The shop

One room, three counters

Enumclaw Vape & Smoke is a single room on Roosevelt Ave with three different shops running down the inside of it.

One long wall is vape — juice, disposables, devices, and the pods and coils in the case beneath. Facing it across the floor is a black wall of glass, with a lit case of hand pipes underneath where nothing repeats. At the end, the maple cigar case.

It's a small room and a lot of shelf. Almost none of it is self-serve — if you can't see what you're after, ask, and it comes out from under the glass.
